exposure: Gestational weight gain (GWG) pattern (total and rate by trimester)
Trimester-specific GWG group (low, medium, high GWG)
outcome: Changes in maternal body composition (fat mass, body water)
cohort: A multi-ethnic cohort of 156 pregnant women and their infants was studied in New York City.
finding: Trimester-specific patterns and rates of gestational weight gain (GWG) are associated with changes in maternal fat mass and body water, and a high rate of second-trimester GWG is linked to higher infant birth weight and length.
